cards.title: AUC Extrapolation Methods
cards.claim: Three extrapolation methods are defined for the tail of the concentration-time curve: 'AUClast' (no extrapolation, integral is zero), 'AUCall' (no extrapolation if the last measured concentration is above LOQ; otherwise linear triangle integration from the last quantifiable point to the subsequent zero-concentration time, under the stated PKNCA convention), and 'AUCinf' (extrapolation using the equation C_last/lambda_z, requiring half-life estimation).
conditions: Availability of terminal half-life (lambda_z) for AUCinf
required_inputs: Terminal elimination rate constant (lambda_z) for AUCinf
limitations: AUCall behavior depends on whether Clast is above or below LLOQ
Extrapolation choices are explicit settings, not automatic defaults

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
